With such an interface, finite-element simulations predict that the channel hotspot temperature of β -Ga2O3 metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFETs) drops by about 50 K at 4 W mm-1 relative to the device without the Si interlayer .

However, the effect of the Si interlayer thickness has not yet been systematically resolved, partly because precise control of an ultrathin buried layer during bonding remains experimentally challenging.
